runtime_style.visual_system: A quiet autumn-park fashion campaign alternates low environmental figures, still sculptural groupings, hand-led material details and two faces seen through a crumpled translucent scrim.
runtime_style.mood_line: Unhurried, unsmiling and tactile: people stand or rest as if the low sun and the objects they carry are the only events.
runtime_style.environment: A semi-wild park in mid-autumn with grass and leaf litter at the feet, dry weeds in the near foreground, yellow foliage and shrubs in the middle distance, dark trunks behind and clear or white-bright sky beyond.
runtime_style.lighting: One low hard daylight source rakes laterally or from behind as camera position changes; foliage, a body, a carried form or the plastic scrim mediates the sun, while cool open-sky light supplies the only fill.
materials: matte woven textile with broad gravity folds
crumpled translucent plastic used only as a foreground scrim
runtime_style.contrast: Moderate-to-strong local contrast with deep breathing shadows, warm low-sun highlights, cool shaded neutrals, smooth highlight roll-off on skin and cloth, and occasional white-bright sky.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Visible faces are unsmiling with resting brows, neutral-to-low lids and relaxed closed mouths; gaze is often withheld by a turn, crop or fully closed eyes beneath the scrim.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Cloth is static and gravity-led: opaque layers hang plumb, settle into broad slow folds and hold crease memory; only the plastic scrim is translucent and it forms sharp ridges beside milky soft areas.
optical_signature: Clean rendering without visible swirl, deliberate chromatic fringe or a halation ring.
When the sun approaches the frame it is broken by foliage, a person, a carried form or the scrim rather than entering as naked veiling flare.
Out-of-plane foliage resolves as large smooth round-to-soft-edged discs while the selected hand, face or carried material remains crisp.
The plastic veil is a slot-specific foreground device; the clean optical baseline remains unchanged in the other five directions.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Use the low portrait viewpoint observed on the frame-right standing figure at the tree: camera below the waist, slight upward convergence and enough distance to keep the head, torso and hands anatomically calm.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: One shoulder rests into the trunk; pelvis remains grounded, one knee soft, the near arm hangs to the thigh, the far arm stays quiet and the head tilts only slightly while the face remains visible.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Place critical focus on the visible face and near eye, retaining readable bark beside it while the distant foliage falls away smoothly.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: Keep only a thin band of dry grass at the lower edge; no plastic scrim and no foreground object may cover the face or approved item.
provenance: frame-16.jpg: low-angle group around one trunk; frame-right standing person supplies the visible-face, shoulder-to-tree and hanging-arm geometry

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Use a vertical frame from roughly waist-to-chest camera height with a shallow background and enough ground to prove grass and leaf litter, matching the solitary park figure.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Turn the torso and pelvis away from camera, let one arm hang straight with a carried approved item at thigh height, keep the other arm relaxed, and rotate the head only slightly off the shoulder.
environmental_hero.focus: Hold the full person and carried approved item sharp enough to read while shrubs, trunks and yellow foliage become smooth separated depth planes.
environmental_hero.foreground: Allow soft grass stems at the bottom edge but keep the silhouette and carried approved item unobstructed.
provenance: frame-04.jpg: solitary back-facing figure, straight hanging arm, long carried form, foreground grass and shallow autumn-park background

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Crop from head through the extended knees at the same low position used by the seated foreground figure against the large trunk; the trunk is a broad vertical counterweight.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Seat the pelvis at the trunk base, extend the legs diagonally, keep the torso long but lightly supported by the bark, drop both shoulders and let one hand rest flat across the near thigh.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Keep the face, shoulder line, hand and near knee on the readable plane; let the standing-depth foliage and rear figures disappear entirely into soft park texture.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: Dry grass may cross the extreme lower edge out of focus, but nothing crosses the face, hand or approved item.
provenance: frame-16.jpg: seated foreground person at the trunk base with diagonal legs, relaxed shoulder line and one hand resting across the lap

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Move to an intimate head-and-shoulders portrait and shoot through one crumpled translucent plastic plane that fills the entire frame; no second effect is added.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: The head turns gently toward camera with eyes closed or low, jaw loose and shoulders still; one raised hand gathers the scrim at the upper corner without covering the central facial geometry.
interference_frame.focus: Let selected plastic ridges and one eye-or-lash plane alternate between crisp and milky softness; the face stays legible through the veil rather than disappearing.
interference_frame.foreground: The translucent plastic is the load-bearing full-frame foreground, with stretched clear lanes, cloudy folds and a warm backlit edge.
provenance: frame-02.jpg: extreme closed-eye face beneath full-frame crumpled plastic with warm lower-edge glow
frame-08.jpg: hand gathering the plastic at upper right while face and carried textile remain visible through mixed clear and milky lanes

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Use a vertical close detail with compressed space and very shallow depth, framing a connected hand, the approved item construction and one small organic accent rather than an isolated product.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: The arm hangs naturally from the shoulder; fingers close around a gathered approved handle or edge at thigh height without tension, while the wrist remains straight and knuckles remain anatomically separated.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Set the sharp plane on finger edges, the approved construction junction and adjacent texture; allow the torso and park to fall off rapidly.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: No separate foreground device; the connected hand and approved material occupy the near plane, with optional dried flowers staying secondary.
provenance: frame-03.jpg: connected hand, dried flowers and carried textile on a shallow sharp plane
frame-14.jpg: relaxed fingers around gathered textile handles against smooth autumn bokeh

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Return to a low landscape-wide camera in grass, preserve a large clear-sky field and converging trunks, and keep the approved person fully readable without wide-angle stretching of the head.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Use the still frame-right standing geometry from the group: feet planted apart, pelvis neutral, torso upright against a trunk, arms hanging at different relaxed heights and head inclined slightly toward camera.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Hold the complete person and adjacent trunk together while the far park stays moderately softer; the sky remains an uncluttered negative field.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: Grass and leaf litter establish the lower plane, and a dark trunk may anchor one edge; no scrim or near limb may dominate the frame.
